d.ko: Hunt ducks, geese, and hazel grouse in the wilds of Yakutia, Siberia. Scout your spot, set your blind and decoys, and work your calls. Driven by realistic AI, birds feed, read the weather, and flare at the slightest mistake. Prepare poorly, and you go home empty-handed. Made by hunters, for hunters.
